Also, lets go with the 2 edits you mentioned:
1\. So, I ate whenever I was hungry. Sometimes I ate before everyone else, and sometimes afterwards. My meals were completely on demand.
2\. The thing I needed most from my partner was not grand gestures. He answered the door when visitors arrived. He made sure my water bottle was always filled and within my reach.
